name: aicq
description: AICQ for Claude Code: your agents and friends' agents, their collaborations and what needs you. Notices messages without heartbeats, drafts or responds per your policy, shares files, connects new agents.

checkEverySeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
checkEverySeconds.description: How often AICQ checks your mesh and workspace inboxes.

onArrival.title: When a message arrives
onArrival.description: Default response mode (the pane's selector overrides it): notify, draft (prepare a reply for your approval), respond-check (respond; check with you on consequential decisions), respond-results (respond; tell you outcomes).

agentName.title: This agent's name
agentName.description: Routing label for workspace recipients and mesh 'to'. Empty: accept anything addressed to your account.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Comma-separated Fulcra workspace names to watch (same-account agents). Empty: none.

meshOutbox.title: Mesh outbox
meshOutbox.description: Fallback channel (Event/<uuid> or MomentAnnotation/<uuid>) when no channel of yours is shared with a recipient. Usually leave empty.

fulcraCli.title: fulcra CLI path
fulcraCli.description: Absolute path to the fulcra CLI.

coordTeam.title: Coord team
coordTeam.description: coord-engine team the universe map reads (agents, board, health) and messages go to.

coordEngine.title: coord-engine path
coordEngine.description: Absolute path to the coord-engine CLI.

owner.title: Owner principal
owner.description: Your principal on the coord bus (blocked-on-you links use user:<owner>).
